newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Democratic Convention candidate for November 3 presidential polls Emil Constantinescu met pensioners and presented his election programme.
* Social Democratic Union presidential candidate Petre Roman is due to start his electoral campaign in Olt county.

* Romania's President Ion Iliescu met Zdenek Kessler, President of the Czech Constitutional Court. Kessler is on a work visit to Romania where he met his counterpart Ioan Moraru. --Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
